Name: Stronger Coffee (Content Pack)
Author: Dayashi
Description:
Makes the coffee +1 speed buff last longer, configurable to last 2 (the vanilla default), 4, 8, or 16 in-game hours. The value is dependent on this buff, but does increase.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed too.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use
[/size]By default the mod makes the buff last 8 in-game hours; if you're happy with that duration then you're good to go as soon as it's in your mod folder. If you wish to change this, however...

[list]
[*]Open up the config.json file.

[*]Change the value behind [b]"duration"[/b] to either "120", "240", "480", or "960". 
[*]This refers to the amount of in-game minutes; other values will not work.
[*]Save the config file and you're done.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Untested in multiplayer.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Dayashi/SVStrongerCoffeeCP]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list]
